observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 214.» (L6) and «p. 215.» (L26) in the left margin; in both the 2 is printed broken, like £.

body L26-L42: the lines stand in a column on the right of the image of the quadrant; the letters B and A stand beside the upper corners of the plate at the height of L26, D and C beside the lower corners between L41 and L42.
body L32-L34: the title of the image is set in bold, its second and third lines indented; «(2).» is roman.
body L35: «Dicit [auctor];» is printed with a semicolon after the bracket.
body L16: a blot stands over the c and the i of «circuli»; it is not a sign.

figure: the image of the mural quadrant is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0231-F01.tex): the plate ABCD; the arc BC about A drawn as four arcs, a heavy one inside; between the outer two the degrees, between the inner two the strokes of every fifth degree and the numbers 5 to 90 from B to C, set along the arc with their tops outward; the line from A through the arc at 45 degrees; beyond the arc on that line a square sighting block with the letter L inside and H beside it; G and K beside the arc.
figure: the arcs are not quite centred on the corner A (their centres lie up to 3.6 pt above it) and the sides BA and DC fall by 0.3 degree to the left; the redrawing keeps the printed geometry.
body L12, L14: specks stand over the v of «verum» (L12) and over the a of «gradus» (L14); they are not accents.
body L23, L24: a short stroke stands over the v of «versus» (L23) and a speck under the l of «similiter» (L24); they are not signs.
figure: in the print the line from A stops at the inner thin arc and appears again inside the sighting block, from the outer arc to the outer side of the block; the redrawing keeps the two pieces.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
